I love mathematics for many reasons, but I wouldn't be pursuing academia if math
wasn't collaborative. Don't hesitate to reach out if you want to chat!

## Organization

I love to organize events/seminars/courses which use math to bring people together
(usually to learn more math). Here's a list of things that are running currently or soon.
Feel free to reach out to me if you have questions about them.

- UMD MATH808S – Selected Topics in Algebra; Varieties over finite fields
